CustomField.description: The generic donor tier key. Referenced by the DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Annual_Donor_Level__c and FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level__c to classify donors. Must match the DeveloperName of this record so the formula evaluation is consistent. Allowed values: Entry, Mid, Major.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The generic donor tier. The FQS_*_Donor_Level__c formula fields on Donor Gift Summary return this value and it is used for list views and reports. A single custom metadata record is expected for each of these picklist values.
CustomField.label: Tier Key
